business_need_date.description: Documented business or clinical control date that the decision must protect (ISO date).

change_fees_usd.description: Sum of the recorded change fees on the changeable itineraries.

changeable_bookings.description: Traveller itineraries that can be re-issued for their recorded change fee.

contingency_usd.description: Events contingency from the policy table for the event's attendee band.

controlled_item_or_record.description: Immutable item, lot set, or transaction record in scope.

decision_timing_status.description: ON_TIME when the selected outcome is on or before the control date; otherwise LATE.

escalation_approval_required.description: Use 1 when an alternative is outside current authority and would need a separate approval; otherwise 0.

excluded_quantity.description: reserved balance held by open venue-hold deposits and pending adjustments

expedited_external_readiness.description: Expedited readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40255.

new_ticket_cost_usd.description: New tickets multiplied by the group fare on the ticketing confirmation.

new_tickets_required.description: Travellers whose basic fare is forfeited and who need a new ticket at the group fare.

observed_quantity.description: Gross observed quantity before applying the control for funding the leadership offsite move.

outcome_vs_control_days.description: Selected outcome date minus the documented control date; positive means late.

per_diem_delta_usd.description: Extra billed days times travellers times the venue country's per-diem rate.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of measure for every controlled quantity: USD.

recommended_incremental_cost_usd.description: Documented incremental spend of the selected option in USD; zero when spend is not a decision driver.

recommended_option.description: Best authorized option identifier after comparing post_adjustment_and_move_standard_ticketing, move_against_gross_remaining_without_adjustment, rush_ticketing_into_6_july_week.

recommended_outcome_date.description: Date produced by the selected option after applying every source constraint (ISO date).

source_quantity.description: incremental cost of moving the leadership offsite to Saltmarsh's week of 2026-07-20 at agenda rev 4 (change fees, new tickets, venue difference, per-diem difference)

standard_external_readiness.description: Standard readiness date independently confirmed for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40255.

supported_quantity.description: usable headroom on the executive travel line after reserved deposits and pending adjustments

transaction_quantity.description: Exact quantity the primary state change may persist.

travellers.description: Required attendees whose home office is not the venue's local office (Lisbon).

venue_delta_usd.description: Target quote total minus the contracted quote total.

Correlated the independent source records to 3400 observed USD.
Removed 1300 USD for reserved balance held by open venue-hold deposits and pending adjustments.
Calculated 3400 observed − 1300 excluded = 2100 supported USD.

Bound the state change to exactly 1250 USD, the measure required by the chosen disposition under the usable-headroom rule and the signed adjustment approval; did not substitute the header or another business quantity.
Kept the order, transfer, or dispense quantity in USD.

Derived 2026-07-21 for move_against_gross_remaining_without_adjustment.

Read 2026-06-29 as the independently confirmed expedited readiness date for Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40255.
Counted 9 required attendees minus the 2 Lisbon locals = 7 travellers; the optional Lisbon data engineer was not counted.
Identified 5 changeable flex itineraries (four Bristol, one Toronto) among the 7 traveller bookings.
Identified 2 forfeited basic fares (Siobhán Quinn, Marcus Lim) that need new tickets.
Summed 85 × 4 + 240 = USD 580 of recorded change fees.
Priced 2 new tickets at the USD 290 group fare on WF-40255 = USD 580.
Calculated SR-5121 (12,900) minus contracted SR-5090 (11,700) = USD 1,200; did not use the alternative SR-5118.
Calculated 1 extra billed day × 7 travellers × USD 70 (Portugal) = USD 490 from the current per-diem table.
Applied the USD 500 contingency for a 10-attendee event from the current contingency table, not the 2024 flat USD 300.
Applied USD 2850 as the documented incremental spend for post_adjustment_and_move_standard_ticketing; did not invent a premium where spend is not a decision driver.
Recognized that rush_ticketing_into_6_july_week remains outside current authority and requires an additional approval.

Calculated 2026-07-21 as the supported outcome date for post_adjustment_and_move_standard_ticketing.
Compared 2026-07-21 with the independent control date 2026-07-24 and calculated a signed variance of -3 day(s).
Reported ON_TIME; did not relabel a controlled but late result as on time.

facts.rubric: Applied the event, the current agenda revision, and the policy to establish 2850 USD for incremental cost of moving the leadership offsite to Saltmarsh's week of 2026-07-20 at agenda rev 4 (change fees, new tickets, venue difference, per-diem difference), with control date 2026-07-24.

facts.statement: Wayfinder's confirmed standard and rush ticketing dates on WF-40255: Wayfinder WF-40255 confirms standard ticketing 2026-07-10 and rush 2026-06-26 (+USD 260) at a USD 290 group fare; travellers are confirmed the next business day; a group-desk confirmation alone proves neither viability nor approval.

facts.rubric: Applied Saltmarsh's open weeks netted against the required attendees' hard conflicts to derive the three option outcomes without displacing a held, booked, or blackout week or a protected commitment.
facts.statement: Saltmarsh's open weeks netted against the required attendees' hard conflicts: Saltmarsh's open weeks are 07-06 and 07-20 (07-27 is the maintenance blackout); the first clear week on or after the 2026-07-13 standard confirmation is 07-20; held, booked, and blackout weeks and protected commitments cannot be displaced.

facts.rubric: Applied AP-DK-0102 only to post_adjustment_and_move_standard_ticketing and EVT-LDR-LIS; kept rush_ticketing_into_6_july_week outside current authority.
facts.statement: AP-DK-0102 covers an adjustment up to USD 1,500 on the travel line with standard ticketing; rush needs Rui Saldanha and anything above the USD 2,000 line ceiling or a reclass needs Ifeoma Okonkwo. facts.rubric: Compared all three alternatives and selected post_adjustment_and_move_standard_ticketing: it is the best currently authorized response that satisfies the usable-headroom rule and the signed adjustment approval.
facts.statement: sessions must end by 2026-07-24 before the investor roadshow, and no booking may change before the shortfall is posted; a faster or broader action has value only if it remains inside the usable-headroom rule and the signed adjustment approval.

options.consequence: post adjustment and move with standard ticketing posts USD 1,250 (750 uncovered + 500 contingency) to the executive travel line, then re-issues five itineraries and issues two new tickets for Saltmarsh's week of 2026-07-20, sessions 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-23, for USD 2,850 of incremental cost inside AP-DK-0102.

options.consequence: move against gross remaining without adjustment would change the bookings on the strength of the USD 3,400 gross balance, but usable headroom after reserved deposits and pending adjustments is USD 2,100, and policy 4.3 forbids changing bookings before the shortfall is posted.
options.label: move_against_gross_remaining_without_adjustment: outcome 2026-07-21, incremental cost USD 2850, FAILS_CURRENT_CONTROL

options.consequence: rush ticketing into the 6 July week would confirm travellers by 2026-06-29 for Saltmarsh's open week of 2026-07-06, two weeks earlier, at USD 2,850 plus the USD 260 rush fee, but AP-DK-0102 names the standard queue only, so the rush queue needs Rui Saldanha.
